combat:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production 2D game combat sprite atlas.
Reference image is user's exact orange fire creature. Depict ONLY the complete central creature, ignore cropped creature at right and handwritten number. Preserve athletic upright orange biped fire lizard, swept pointed head horns, turquoise eyes, cream belly, dark crimson flame stripes on limbs and curved long tail, blazing large yellow/red tail flame, tiny cheek flames, white toe claws. Same clean outlined cel-shaded cartoon as reference, consistent anatomy and proportions, no redesign.
Output actual transparent background PNG, EXACT 6 columns x 5 rows equal square cells, ideally 1536 x 1280. Six sequential animation frames per row. All face RIGHT three quarter side view, fixed camera, centered pelvis, consistent body/head size; ground feet at 88% cell height. Generous clear margins. Each whole character AND effects entirely inside its cell, no overlapping cells. No text, labels, grids, scenery, shadows.
Row 1 claw attack: neutral ready, pull claw back windup, torso twist anticipation, fast forward claw slash, follow through, recover near neutral. Small orange swipe ONLY around extended claw.
Row 2 fire casting: neutral, inhale with chest expansion, cheeks/neck tense, mouth open releasing small short flame to right, flame dwindles, close mouth recover. Flame small and within cell; engine renders projectiles.
Row 3 fiery dash: crouched anticipation, push-off, low forward sprint pose, stride opposite leg, braking, recover near neutral; tiny embers behind tail, no giant effect.
Row 4 backstep: neutral, weight shift back, front foot lifts while rear pushes, light backward hop pose, rear foot touches ground, settle neutral. Still face RIGHT throughout.
Row 5 crouch loop: low crouched guard, subtle breathing compressed, head rises a tiny amount, exhale, soft blink, back to start. Keep ground and head stable.
Coherent successive drawings, gradual limb motion, tail overlaps following body's inertia, consistent size and stroke, no extra limbs.
